basis: The Union Registry public extracts are Commission-owned content: the Commission's own legal notice states its reuse policy ('Unless otherwise indicated (e.g. in individual copyright notices), content owned by the EU on this website is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) licence'), read 2026-10-21 at https://commission.europa.eu/legal-notice_en, and the Union Registry Public Website (DG CLIMA) carries that notice. The EEA's ISO-19115 metadata for its Union Registry-derived EU ETS product independently states 'License CC-BY 4.0' with copyright holder 'European Commission, European Environment Agency (EEA)'. CC BY 4.0 permits sharing and adapting for any purpose, commercially, provided attribution is given and changes are indicated, so the standing defaults apply: our code and documentation are MIT, our rights in the derived compilation are dedicated CC0-1.0, and the source's own terms are preserved, never relicensed.

third_party.terms: MIT - the harness benchmark's own runner files, shipped verbatim and unmodified (bundled sha256 equal the benchmark's declared hashes, recorded in the baseline job result)
third_party.permission: The benchmark checkout is read-only; permission to distribute verbatim copies of its runner files covers the distributed copies only

compilation.scope: Our contribution - the installation-year row selection and eligibility frame, the derived net-short label, the settlement-lagged feature derivations, the temporal partition, and the packaging - is dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0. The dedication covers only our contribution: the underlying Union Registry public extracts keep their own designation and remain subject to the Commission's CC BY 4.0 reuse terms, whose attribution condition carries through to every copy of the derived data. Nothing here relicenses the source or presents CC0 as the source's terms.

source.status: European Commission reuse policy, CC BY 4.0 unless otherwise indicated: applies to Commission-owned content on the Union Registry Public Website, whose Data Download section publishes the EUTL public extracts. Reuse is allowed provided appropriate credit is given and changes are indicated. The dataset's derived rows are indicated changes: a row selection, a derived binary label and derived features, not the Commission's own product.
evidence: [https://commission.europa.eu/legal-notice_en, read 2026-10-21] 'The European Commission's reuse policy is implemented by the Commission Decision of 12 December 2011 on the reuse of Commission documents. Unless otherwise indicated (e.g. in individual copyright notices), content owned by the EU on this website is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) licence. This means that reuse is allowed, provided appropriate credit is given and changes are indicated.'

[EEA ISO-19115 metadata inside the Union Registry data zip, read 2026-10-21] 'License CC-BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Copyright holder: European Commission, European Environment Agency (EEA).' - independent confirmation from the EU family that Union Registry-derived data carries CC BY 4.0.

Contains Commission-owned content licensed under CC BY 4.0.
source.citation: European Commission, Directorate-General for Climate Action. Union Registry Public Website, EUTL public extracts: operators' yearly activity data (daily extract). https://union-registry-data.ec.europa.eu/report/eu-registry-data-download. Licensed under CC BY 4.0 (Commission reuse policy). Derived dataset: EU ETS installation net-short prediction task (not a Commission official product).
source.derived_labelling: Labelled as a derived research dataset throughout; it is not the European Commission's official product and the Commission has not reviewed or endorsed it. The publisher's own designation, attribution and suggested citation are preserved verbatim, and changes from the source are indicated (row selection, derived label, derived features).

conditions: Attribution to the European Commission (DG CLIMA, Union Registry public extracts) as the source, with the CC BY 4.0 licence named, in every copy of the data.
Changes are indicated: the dataset ships a row selection, a derived binary label and derived features, and is labelled as derived, never as the Commission's official product.
Our contribution is dedicated CC0-1.0; the source's CC BY 4.0 terms are preserved and carry through unchanged.
Our code and documentation are MIT.

operator_acceptance.note: No operator acceptance is needed or recorded: the source states terms (Commission reuse policy, CC BY 4.0) that permit redistribution with attribution and indication of changes, and this release stays within them.
